title: PRE-MOVEMENT WALKAROUND
description: Damage check, fluid leaks, and tire condition before moving a vehicle off the return lane.

questions.prompt: A returned car has a small dent on the driver-side door that was not on the existing damage record. What is the correct first action?

options.text: Drive it to the wash and report at end of shift
Photograph the damage, tag the car, and notify a supervisor before moving
Touch up the area and continue
Ignore it — small dents are normal wear

questions.explanation: Unreported damage must be documented at the point of discovery. Photograph, tag, and escalate before moving the vehicle.

questions.prompt: You should always check under a returned vehicle for fluid leaks before driving it to the wash bay.
questions.explanation: A leaking vehicle moved to the wash bay can spread fluid across the floor and create a slip hazard for the wash crew.

questions.prompt: Which of the following must be checked before moving a returned vehicle? Select all that apply.
questions.explanation: Fuel, damage, customer items, and dash warnings all factor into status assignment. Radio presets are not part of the check.
